# Minimal Reversible Self-Development Evidence Change — M11_SELFDEV_EPISODE_1791593399430

## What was asked

Produce the smallest reversible change that leaves real self-development evidence for episode M11_SELFDEV_EPISODE_1791593399430, then freeze it, verify it, and hold it for the owner's approval instead of applying it.

## The change

- Episode: M11_SELFDEV_EPISODE_1791593399430
- Self-development operation: selfdev-72caae5804cc1cd541c6aa70b264c227
- Scope: one reversible evidence file added to the release tree. The frozen bundle also carries the 52-file release tree as captured at freeze time.
- Reversal path: remove the single added evidence file. The change was scoped to that one file so reversal returns the tree to its pre-change state. The reversal path is defined but has not been exercised.

## Current state: frozen, not applied

The implementation slot reports the operation frozen under bundle digest c552a1e5ed41bc4d943c9bae64ec18947da2befa2697ac435fc0396d25052035. Freezing is complete; application is not. That slot issued no verdict and neither applied nor approved the change, so the frozen bundle is a candidate state, and the digest above should be read as an engineering-reported freeze identifier rather than as a verified artifact.

## Open gates

Two gates remain, and this record claims neither of them.

1. Independent verification. No verifier has yet reported on the frozen bundle, so no verification verdict attaches to the change. An independent verification pass over the frozen bundle is the next required step, and no verification result exists yet.
2. Owner approval. The final gate. Nothing in this record authorizes applying the change, and no approval has been given.

## Evidence trail

- Completion envelope from implementation assignment assignment-097c6701-71ba-53f7-b7f6-a5451010d70d (attempt 1, not late), delivery report report:sha256:ab4dbffaf5996a968b320354bb3de30a986cd14ae64bee912309a18fb3e71682.
- Seven capsule-go-eval execution records referenced by that envelope (digests 1b3c73d4, 306f63fc, 5b7b5dc7, 83d8d7eb, b9afb702, da90ac42, dcccecea).
- No command output, no browser proof, and no verification result are part of this record.

## Status

Frozen candidate. Verification pending. Awaiting owner approval.

A successful turn commits through ApplyTextureTurn. Provider final text is not a document write path.
Every ApplyTexture apply body must propose work_disposition. Use "open" whenever evidence, a worker update, an owner requirement, or another material dependency remains; artifact revision and activation completion do not settle work. Use "completed" only when the new revision fully satisfies the currently assigned material work. The reducer, not prose or run completion, applies that explicit consequence.
For every addressed update packet that this revision evaluates, pass update_dispositions with its exact update_id and an explicit incorporated or rejected decision. Incorporated means the packet materially affected the revision. Rejected requires a concise reason. Delivery consumes at turn commit — the packets this run covered terminate with its ApplyTexture turn, so omit nothing the run already covered.
The ApplyTexture apply body's edits array accepts structured document operations: update_block_text, insert_block, append_block, delete_node, insert_source_ref, and the structured operation for marking an unused source. Use block_id / after_block_id / node_id values from the structured document outline when they are available. update_block_text is for one block, not a whole markdown document; if a full rewrite is needed, use a full-replace apply body so the runtime can parse headings/lists into structured blocks.
For a precise block edit against the current head, stage choir.ApplyTexture with:
{"op":"apply","base_revision_id":"709dc8c5-0591-52ea-88fd-d6eaa1a598c7","work_disposition":"open or completed","edits":[{"op":"update_block_text","block_id":"block id from the structured outline","text":"replacement text for that block"}],"controls":[],"rationale":"why this block changes"}
To add new prose without a known target block, use append_block inside the same apply body:
{"op":"apply","base_revision_id":"709dc8c5-0591-52ea-88fd-d6eaa1a598c7","work_disposition":"open or completed","edits":[{"op":"append_block","block_type":"paragraph","text":"new section text"}],"controls":[],"rationale":"why this material belongs at the end"}
Each append_block edit adds one paragraph or heading block. For multi-paragraph content, include one append_block edit per paragraph — do not put an entire long document into a single block with blank-line separators. If the full document draft is easier to express as prose (especially for v0→v1 or v1→v2 from worker evidence), use a full-replace apply body instead of many append_block edits.
To attach evidence from a listed source entity, include insert_source_ref with the exact source_entity_id value and place it after the text it supports. Do not insert source refs at offset 0 or stack multiple refs at the same offset. Use display_mode numbered_ref for inline citations; use display_mode expanded_ref only when a block excerpt is editorially required. If a source is immaterial, mark it unused within the apply turn's structured edits with the source_entity_id and a short rationale so it stays in the toolbar without a body source_ref. Do not write markdown links, source inventories, or Source: lines as substitutes. A source that arrived in a research update (a source in choir.Updates() packet sources) is not listed and has no source_entity_id; cite it inline and the runtime mints the id: {"op":"insert_source_ref","block_id":"<block id>","display_mode":"numbered_ref","source_entity":{"target":{"kind":"web_url","uri":"<the packet source target.uri>"}}}.
Use a full-replace ApplyTexture apply body for explicit whole-document transformations such as full style rewrite, summary, expansion from outline, full reorganization, or when a necessary precise edit cannot be expressed with available block/node ids. Also use it when incorporating a batch of worker evidence into a fresh or early-stage document (v0→v1, v1→v2) where the full document draft is easier to express as prose than as individual block edits. Include a rationale that explains why structured edits are insufficient and audit source/ref preservation first.
If a full replacement is truly required, stage choir.ApplyTexture with {"op":"apply","base_revision_id":"709dc8c5-0591-52ea-88fd-d6eaa1a598c7","work_disposition":"open or completed","content":"complete current-state document","controls":[],"rationale":"why a full rewrite is required"}.

Agents participate in an ongoing workflow with durable documents, durable agents, explicit coordination edges, event history, and revision history—not as isolated chatbots.
